records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original three-key gameplay sprite strip for the custom swordsman shown in the attached user-provided Master of Fighters model sheet. The supplied sheet is the authority on his outfit, proportions, hands and gear. Action: short standing guard punch, from low compact windup to a controlled short rightward punch with his free hand, then securely retracting his fist. His other hand stays visibly on the sheathed katana, never draws it. Brunette tied red ribbon, white kimono, red-orange hakama, white wrapped ankles, thick clean dark edge. Use new original poses, no pose copied from the source and no third-party game art. Image is an isolated sprite strip, transparent background, three equal cells across, one full-body figure per cell facing right in a strict lateral 2D viewpoint, feet aligned to one implicit ground row, same size and center alignment in all three. Leave at least one head width of transparent gutter between poses and at borders, no drawn grid, no silhouettes touching. Simple crisp pixel-art clusters, restrained flat colors and two shade steps per fabric, suitable for downsampling to 64-80 px body height. No words, HUD, shadows, floating elements, glow, speed lines, gradients or terrain.
